purpose: Forward-only immutable contract-rule field versions and separate metadata/book request receipt clocks; supports later rule-aware research, not trading or historical backfill.
source: Existing unauthenticated DemoMarkets.quote market GET plus book GET; no additional request, source, credential, schedule or model call.
availability: First local metadata response receipt only. Server updated_time, publication time, historical rule version, completeness between observations and unseen revisions are not inferred.
integrity: SHA256 canonical JSON field projection, append-only versions and quote receipts, immutable protocol. A version hash does not prove a publisher's historical byte object. Missing fields are retained as null, not invented.
failure: Expose invalid clocks, identity mismatch, protocol drift or capacity in archive status. Retain all earlier evidence. No pruning/reset/backfill or execution authority. Archive failure never changes a frozen signal or retries an order.
verification: Synthetic deduplication/change/restart/protocol/clock/capacity tests plus fresh deployed nonzero archive rows and exact worker revision. No claim of profitability or complete source-publication ingestion.
